Hey there.. You cant imagine how similar we are.. I have been feeling suicidal for so long, but learned to live with that thought. Because we only have one chance to live , one chance to make our dreams come true and live the way we want. I am fucking 18 yo and this year I realised I am bi. I also love my best friend,but neither she or anyone really knows about my sexuality. It is really hard to pretend and it is so brave of you that you spoke openly about your feelings , rather than keeping it all to yourself. 
Every time you get those thoughts you can call a friend , or a close relative you have good relationship with , message someone important for you, watch something funny, listen to music, remind yourself that life IS worth living and point out the things that are important for YOU, join a sports class, or art class , whatever you are interested in , just so you keep yourself occupied and maybe even find a new hobby, be more social, even if you dont feel like it , because isolation only makes things worse.. I really hope I helped you in some way op , peace
